topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: You ever met someone online, thought you'd never see 'em in the flesh? Well, life twists like a double-cross on a rainy night. Turns out, this digital shadow's been haunting the same streets as me. I figure, why wait for the next dark alley to throw us together? I'm setting up a meet, under the glow of a flickering streetlamp, maybe. See if the eyes match the grin from the screen. I've seen too many faces change once the real world breathes on 'em. This could be just another angle, or maybe something that sticks. Either way, I'll have my wits sharp and my guard up. Can’t be too careful, not in this town.
